title: Is toggle sprint allowed?

replies.author: Goodnighht
replies.body:
Toggle Sprint and Toggle Sneak are allowed, yes. The only requirement is that when you are using Toggle Sneak you cannot be able to open your inventory, chests, or any sort of GUI and stay crouched. It should make you stand back up when you open those things.

Now, to your issue with knockback I would say to try to use one of these things:

Toggle Sneak/Sprint + Optifine. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PBjDIfRCrVM (This video gives you the links to the correct sites, and explains how to download and use the mods.)

Or

Laby Mod: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oim2KPomnss (This video also gives you the links, as well as explains how to load it into Minecraft.)
